headline: Short easy return after travel
summary: Garmin recorded 5h 43m of confirmed sleep with a score of 71. Sleeping heart rate was 68 bpm, close to recent baselines; overnight HRV was 43 ms versus a 39 ms weekly average, Body Battery was 67 on waking, and Training Readiness was 79. Run 30–40 minutes easy and conversational today, with no quality work or make-up mileage after travel.

recovery.context: Confirmed Sydney sleep window: 29 September 00:05–05:48. Garmin estimated 7h 50m of sleep need, leaving a 2h 07m shortfall.

recovery.context: 0.2 bpm above the prior 7-night valid-sample average of 67.8 and 0.9 bpm above the prior 14-night valid-sample average of 67.1. Garmin had no valid sleep HR for 27 September, so baselines use available nights only.

recovery.context: Garmin classifies HRV as balanced; the overnight value is 4 ms above the weekly average.

recovery.context: Garmin reported 1 minute of recovery time after waking. Readiness supports easy movement but does not erase the short sleep or recent travel.

recovery.label: Recent load
recovery.context: Garmin classifies the ratio as low. This reflects reduced travel-week training and is not a reason to add make-up mileage or intensity.

recommendation.title: 30–40 minutes easy and conversational
details: Run for 30–40 minutes at RPE 2–3, approximately 5–6.5 km depending on comfortable pace.
Keep the effort conversational and the route uncomplicated; do not add tempo work, intervals, hills, strides, a fast finish, or make-up distance.
Use the first 10 minutes as a check after travel. Continue only if coordination, energy, breathing, and gait feel normal.
recommendation.alternative: Take 20–30 minutes of easy walking or full rest if unusually sleepy, flat, dizzy, dehydrated, ill, or if the warm-up does not settle.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Reduce or stop for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual sleepiness, dehydration symptoms, illness, chest symptoms, or any other concerning symptom. Current symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

signals.label: Sleep constraint

signals.label: Post-travel load
signals.interpretation: Load is low after travel, but rebuilding should be gradual rather than compensated with intensity or extra mileage.

caveats: Sleeping-HR baselines use valid prior nights only; Garmin supplied no valid overnight record for 27 September.
Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, and load values are device measurements; coaching interpretation is stated separately.
No sensor-source inference was made because no prior-day activity was recorded.
The temporary travel schedule expired after 27 September; today's recommendation returns to Sydney context while still accounting for recent long-haul travel.
